## Body

## Security verdict: PASS WITH NOTES

PR #220, final round 2, at **59a35cdc15271eeffc5dab63c5178c53ec108ebd**, reviewing the delta from `0eb43f285c5ede32ceccc232f7f23a6c150df23b` under C33/C34. **S220-001 is closed for the live-successor case; S220-N001 and S220-N002 are addressed.**

| Repair | Source evidence |
|---|---|
| Live-successor veto | `crates/daemon/src/http/lifecycle.rs:240-246` returns `Other(holder)` before considering `Own`. The predecessor/successor regression uses identical PID/start/pane bindings and asserts successor naming with no kill command (`798-861`). |
| Shared close authority | `lifecycle.rs:326-358,496` shares `may_close` with the memory-turn continuation (`http/memory_turn.rs:364-419`). The designated-prime exception still requires a parentless seat and recorded process observed dead/recycled; live/unknown evidence or failed project reads refuse. |
| Held continuation | The continuation rereads and compares the target's incarnation, calls the shared predicate, and closes with the observed descriptor. The store transaction compares that exact row (`crates/store/src/registry.rs:61-74`). The held dead-parentless-holder regression asserts continuation and tombstone (`daemon/tests/memory_turn_http.rs:379-400`). |
| No-launch pane query | `crates/tmux/src/lib.rs:877-893` uses `query_live` only; parsing/read failures query the live pane list. Successful absence is Gone; a present pane with unreadable details is an error; no live client is unavailable. Errors/unavailability produce unchecked advice, not a kill command. Both query paths forbid starting a client (`control.rs:236-260`; `lib.rs:1099-1104`). |
| Holder rendering | The holder now uses `pij_core::render::seat` (`lifecycle.rs:310-312`). |

**S220-N003, C34 follow-up: registry-holder-read-failclosed.** `lifecycle.rs:271-287` still converts a registry-list error into no holder via `.await.ok()`. Otherwise-valid process facts can then produce `Own`. Therefore registry-read failure is not part of the proven fail-closed guarantee. No normal-use triggering case was established; this new round-2 failure-hardening observation is a follow-up, not a renewed S220-001 block.
